notes.title: Patch Release 2024-11-15
notes.notes:
[h3]Interface Functions and Tips[/h3]
[list]
[*] A "Rule Book" interface has been added to help explain the complex internal operating mechanisms of the game. Although this is not the final solution, it can at least temporarily relieve users' confusion.
[/list]

[h3]Interface Layout and Button Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The position of the pause button has been adjusted so that it is placed together with the x2 and x4 buttons. This makes it more logical.
[*] A more prominent "Delete Gathering Point Button" has been added.
[/list]

Windows can no longer be freely dragged and scaled, which avoids the problem of the window size not being compatible with the game.
